title: Jose was incredible....
text: Jose was incredible. Funny, knowledgeable and friendly. Learning about his city was fascinating. And places we went to were fantastic
author: Andrew_B

title: Your very own Barcelona
text: The personal touch of seeing and hearing all about Barcelona with your own personal guide.  Our guide Miguel was interesting, very knowledgeable and funny
author: Sally_C

title: Best Tuk Tuk Tour we've ever done.
text: Dianna, our Tour guide was amazing. Her knowledge and driving skills were excellent. The biggest asset is that the tour begins at the place you can park. You don't have to search for parking. It does cost to park but it is worth it.
author: lynda_v

title: Awesome tour
text: This was one of the best tours I've done with Viator.  Roger kept the whole tour interesting and was got a great overview of the entire city.  He definitely knew exactly where to take us for great views and pictures. It was much better than a hop on and off tour.  I highly recommend this tour!  Try to do it the first day or so while in the city.  Because it was Thursday, we asked for a good place (not a tourist trap) to have authentic paella.  He suggested a restaurant and several markets to check out.  The restaurant we went to had the best seafood paella I've ever eaten.  Every thing we ate
author: MICHELLE_W

title: To do
text: Experience at the top, we had 15 minutes at Parc Montjuic to take pictures. Our driver was very nice. That's it!
author: F683RYelodieg

title: Top Tuk Tuk
text:
On the occasion of a cruise stop, I reserved for 11 people this nice tour around the city of Barcelona. Everything very well organized, from booking, to meeting place details to fantastic guides. The whole group appreciated your Service.
Thanks again and congratulations again for this new idea of experiencing the city in an ecological way and in a few hours.
author: Pellegrini_Tamara

title: Tuk tuk tour
text: This was a great way to see much of the city in a short time. The tour took us to places we would never have visited on our own.  We had many stops with great views for pictures. Tour guide was very cheerful and very knowledgeable about popular landmarks.
author: Keith_K
